the proposed DUCDA method can effectively transfer the knowledge learned from the source domain to the target domain, and thus can improve the classification performance of the target domain.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the domain adaptation can be performed in the early convolutional layers as well as the top fully connected layer of CNN models.
the domain adaptation process should be conducted on the whole DNN model, rather than arbitrarily constrained near the end of DNN models.

, the attention transfer in convolutional domain adaptation can be effectively utilized for unsupervised domain adaptation, and can be integrated with fully connected domain adaptation to further improve the generalization ability in cross-domain learning.
